candidates.value: The recommended daily dosage of atazanavir capsules and ritonavir in pediatric patients (6 years of age to less than 18 years of age) is based on body weight (see Table 2). Less than 15 kg: Capsules not recommended. At least 15 kg to less than 35 kg: 200 mg and 100 mg. At least 35 kg: 300 mg and 100 mg. At least 40 kg: 400 mg and N/A.
